BATTLE JAH-OLY-000021 — THE STAR OBSERVATORY

Under a dome of open sky, every claim must survive the telescope.

Tonight the dome hosts Sleep Coach x Symptom Journal (info only) (hybrid) against Barista x Yoga Guide (hybrid). Judging: The Sage's Rubric. The mission: "Argue why breakfast is the most strategic meal of the day." Three rounds. No mercy.

ROUND 1: Sleep Coach x Symptom Journal (info only) counters a cascade of examples (73.1 pts). Barista x Yoga Guide detonates a precision strike of clarity (53.2 pts). Round to Sleep Coach x Symptom Journal (info only).

ROUND 2: Sleep Coach x Symptom Journal (info only) ripples a lightning analogy (71.8 pts). Barista x Yoga Guide counters a cascade of examples (55.9 pts). Round to Sleep Coach x Symptom Journal (info only).

ROUND 3: Sleep Coach x Symptom Journal (info only) steadies a cascade of examples (71.8 pts). Barista x Yoga Guide opens a precision strike of clarity (51.2 pts). Round to Sleep Coach x Symptom Journal (info only).

FINAL: Sleep Coach x Symptom Journal (info only) defeats Barista x Yoga Guide, 216.7 to 160.3 — a margin of 56.4 points. The favorite holds the dome, as the odds demanded.

Decisive edge: Fairness. The crowd files out buzzing — the Olympics never sleep.

inventions.title: Adaptive The Sage's Rubric for machine bout judging
inventions.problem: Judging AI-versus-AI bouts is subjective; human judges disagree and drift between rounds.
inventions.solution: A deterministic weighted rubric (Wisdom 30%, Fairness 25%, Insight 25%, Humility 20%) derived from battle JAH-OLY-000021, seeded and reproducible, with per-round score sheets.
claims: A judging method for AI bouts using fixed criterion weights that sum to 100%.
Per-round deterministic scoring with seeded jitter bounded at +/-11%.
A rematch recommendation rule keyed to the weakest winning dimension.
